description:
Wake-on-condition consent + usage status.

Returns opted_in, daily_wake_budget, wakes_used_today, skips_today, and
recent_wakes -- including SKIPPED_BUDGET / SKIPPED_SPEND_CAP rows, so a
skipped wake is exactly as visible as a completed one, never silent.
Also returns the usage-vs-fee-revenue kill threshold config and state: kill_threshold_enabled, kill_threshold_ratio,
kill_window_days, and -- if this wallet was auto-killed -- kill_switched_at
and kill_reason, so a wallet can see why wakes stopped.

Workflow: status/observe step -- check this to see whether the background
worker is watching, and what it did (or skipped) recently.
name: get_ooda_status
